summary: Iteration 6 testing of the Weekly Super Bonus Challenge (invite 3 friends → $5 bonus). Backend: 7 new pytest tests added, all pass; full suite 33/33 pass (5 auth + 4 economics + 7 referrals + 2 public stats + 8 leaderboard regression + 7 new challenge). Frontend: SuperBonusChallenge card renders correctly on /app/dashboard and /app/referrals for admin in green 'Unlocked!' state with checkmark, 3 of 3 qualified, 100% bar, no countdown pill (correctly hidden when completed). No console errors, no regressions.

minor.issue: week_start/week_end ISO strings are built as naive datetime + 'Z' suffix (e.g. '2026-04-20T00:00:00Z'). It parses correctly but the datetime object from isoformat() is actually naive — the 'Z' is cosmetic. Clients that do Date.parse in JS handle it fine, but it is technically a malformed ISO8601 (should be '2026-04-20T00:00:00+00:00' or the datetime should be tz-aware before formatting).
Uses datetime.utcnow() (deprecated in Python 3.12+). Recommend datetime.now(timezone.utc) consistently.

critical_code_review_comments: Concurrency safety: record_qualifying_referral uses find_one_and_update with $addToSet (atomic for set membership) AND a guarded update_one({super_bonus_paid: false}, {$set: super_bonus_paid: true}) — the modified_count==1 check guarantees the $5 is credited exactly once per week per referrer even under concurrent 3rd-friend task completions. Correct.

Idempotency verified: even when a 4th unique friend signs up + completes a task (admin already at 3/3), no extra $5 is paid; balance delta was < $1 (only the small referral payout). Confirmed by test_additional_task_by_existing_friend_does_not_re_pay.
Dedup verified: same referred_user_id added to $addToSet counts once — a friend completing 3 tasks yields qualified_count=1 (test_challenge_dedup_same_friend_multiple_tasks).

End-to-end verified: fresh referrer + 3 distinct friends each completing 1 task → challenge.completed=true, qualified_count=3, referrer balance delta ≈ $5.03 ($0.01 × 3 referral payouts + $5 super bonus), super_bonuses_earned counter incremented.
Week boundary: week_start = Monday 00:00 UTC (weekday()==0 verified), week_end = ~7 days later minus 1µs. Rolls over every Monday 00:00 UTC as spec'd.
Failure isolation: pay_referrer wraps record_qualifying_referral in try/except so weekly-challenge errors never block task completion — good defensive design.
Auth enforcement: GET /api/referrals/challenge returns 403 (FastAPI get_current_user default) without bearer token — acceptable; test accepts 401/403.
Frontend component: gracefully returns null on loading or axios error (setData(null)) — will not crash the page if endpoint is temporarily down. Good.
Frontend: countdown pill is correctly conditional on !completed; green/checkmark vs purple/rocket styling toggle is clean.
Minor: countdown tick interval 60s is fine; on a long-idle session the 'Resets in Xd Yh' could lag by up to 1 minute — acceptable UX.
